The brand aims to balance modern messaging with the glamour consumers desire, following last year's relaunched show which featured a diverse cast and emphasized comfort over traditional sexiness, while also integrating shoppable elements with Amazon. Despite recent efforts to regain market share and cater to a female gaze, customer comments indicate a strong desire for the "old glamour" and iconic wings from previous shows.

title: The Marzetti Company Launches Buffalo Wild Wings Hot Sauces; Tanya Berman Comments
summary: The Marzetti Company has partnered with Buffalo Wild Wings to launch a new line of four hot sauces: Original, Chipotle, Habanero, and Blazin'. These 5-ounce bottles are currently available exclusively on Amazon, with plans for broader retail expansion in 2026. Tanya Berman, President of Retail at The Marzetti Company, expressed enthusiasm for expanding their partnership with the iconic brand known for its bold flavors.

title: Procter & Gamble beats estimates but warns tariffs will start to weigh on earnings
summary: Procter & Gamble reported quarterly results that beat Wall Street's expectations but issued fiscal 2026 guidance anticipating a $1 billion hit due to higher costs from tariffs. The company expects mid-single-digit price increases on about a quarter of its items due to these tariffs. P&G is also undergoing a restructuring plan that includes cutting 7,000 nonmanufacturing roles over the next two years.

title: Union Pacific, Norfolk Southern seek 1st transcontinental railroad through a massive merger
summary: Union Pacific is proposing an $85 billion merger with Norfolk Southern to create the first transcontinental railroad in the U.S., a deal that could prompt further consolidation in the rail industry. While the merger aims to streamline deliveries and reduce costs, it faces intense scrutiny from antitrust regulators and concerns from some shippers about potential monopolies. The proposal values Norfolk Southern at approximately $320 per share and anticipates significant cost savings and revenue boosts for the combined entity.

title: QQQI ETF Delivers 14% Yield and NAV Growth on Nasdaq-100 Covered Calls
summary: The NEOS Nasdaq-100 High Income ETF (QQQI) has achieved a 14% trailing-twelve-month dividend yield along with 7% Net Asset Value (NAV) growth since its inception. This is primarily due to its covered call strategy on the Nasdaq-100 index, which involves writing covered calls and selectively purchasing out-of-the-money calls. The fund has also demonstrated a 98% capture ratio of QQQ's total return and offers tax efficiencies through Section 1256 contracts, outperforming peer ETFs like JEPQ and QYLD over the last year.

title: United Parcel Service Q2 2025 Earnings Call Transcript
authors: ['PJ Guido', 'Carol Tomé', 'Brian Dykes', 'Justine Weiss', 'Ben Mohr', 'Bruce Chan', 'Rob Salmon', 'Ravi Shanker', 'Nando Cesarone', 'Conor Cunningham', 'Jordan Alliger', 'Ken Hoexter', 'Joe Hafling', 'Jake Lacks', 'Kate Gutmann', 'Matt Guffey']
summary: United Parcel Service (UPS) held its Q2 2025 earnings call, discussing Q2 financial results, strategic actions, and outlook. Despite a complex macro environment with evolving trade policies, UPS is on track to remove approximately $3.5 billion in expenses this year through its Amazon glide-down plan, network reconfiguration, and Efficiency Reimagined initiatives. The company reported consolidated revenue of $21.2 billion and operating profit of $1.9 billion, with a focus on improving revenue quality and managing challenges like decreased Ground Saver volume and lower-than-anticipated employee attrition.

title: First Lowe’s store in boomtown secures incentives deal
summary: Lowe's Cos Inc. has secured an incentives deal from the City of Kaufman for a new 137,000-square-foot store. The Kaufman City Council approved an economic development deal that will provide Lowe's with a grant to cover half of its site infrastructure costs in the city east of Dallas.

title: Labcorp Introduces Test Finder, a First-of-Its-Kind Generative AI Tool to Simplify Lab Test Search
summary: Labcorp has launched Test Finder, a generative AI tool developed with Amazon Web Services to simplify lab test selection for healthcare providers. This tool allows providers to use plain language to find relevant tests, reducing administrative burden and freeing up time for patient care. Test Finder is designed to improve clinical workflow and provide efficient access to comprehensive diagnostic information.

title: Teradyne Stock Soars: Time to Buy?
summary: Teradyne Inc. stock (NASDAQ: TER) surged by 16.2% due to strong Q2 earnings driven by its Semiconductor Test group and AI-focused System-on-a-Chip solutions. UBS raised its price target to $120, and Cathie Wood's ARK Investment acquired 179.2K shares, reflecting investor optimism despite a JPMorgan downgrade. The company's robust financials, including a 59.4% gross margin and low debt-to-equity ratio, combined with strategic partnerships like Universal Robots' work with Amazon, position it for continued growth and resilience in the tech sector.

title: Teradyne Surges Amid Strong Q2 Results and Amazon Robotics Deal
summary: Teradyne Inc. experienced a significant stock surge of 20.88% following robust Q2 2025 results, which included surpassing EPS and revenue predictions, and a major deal with Amazon for robotic arms potentially worth $400M. The company's positive outlook is further bolstered by UBS raising its price target to $120 and Cathie Wood’s ARK Investments acquiring 179,200 shares. This performance highlights Teradyne's strong financial health and strategic positioning in the robotics and semiconductor test sectors.

title: Hyperscale Data clarifies $XRP acquisitions will remain on company books
summary: Hyperscale Data announced its plan to keep all $XRP acquisitions on its balance sheet, clarifying that these assets will not be owned by its subsidiary, Ault Capital Group (ACG), which it plans to divest by December 31, 2025. This strategic move aims to transform Hyperscale Data into a "pureplay data center business" despite facing significant debt and negative EBITDA. The company also reported a 45% increase in Q2 revenue and plans to expand its Michigan data center campus.

title: CBRE Arranges Two Major Leases for iDC Logistics in Southern California, Totaling Over 1.1 Million Square Feet
summary: CBRE has facilitated two major lease agreements for iDC Logistics in Southern California, encompassing over 1.1 million square feet of industrial space. These leases include an 844,311 square-foot Class A industrial facility in San Bernardino and a 260,000 square-foot facility in the City of Industry, which will serve as a manufacturing hub for consumer electronics. These expansions support iDC Logistics' national growth strategy and commitment to U.S. manufacturing.

title: DTE Energy to supply 3GW electricity to Big Tech data centres
summary: DTE Energy is currently in discussions to provide over 3GW of electricity to Big Tech data centers, with plans to finalize the first contract by the end of 2025. The utility is also in preliminary talks to supply an additional 4GW and intends to leverage existing infrastructure, build new battery storage, and potentially construct new natural gas-fired power generation plants to meet the soaring demand driven by AI expansion. This move comes as US power companies face increasing requests for energy from data-intensive tech facilities, leading DTE to increase infrastructure investments.

title: Celestial Seasonings expands functional teas
summary: Celestial Seasonings, a brand of The Hain Celestial Group, is expanding its functional tea portfolio with four new offerings designed to meet various emotional and physical wellness needs. The new teas, including She-Well Raspberry Leaf, Good Vibes lemon mint, Detox Blend Dandelion, and an Everyday Wellness variety pack, are initially available at Walmart and online, with broader retail distribution planned. The expansion underscores the growing consumer interest in incorporating wellness rituals into daily routines through beverages.

title: Northern Trust Universe Data: Equity Markets Drive Strong Second Quarter Results for Institutional Investors
summary: Institutional investment plans achieved strong returns in the second quarter of 2025, primarily driven by a significant rebound in U.S. equities, propelled by investor excitement around artificial intelligence. The Northern Trust All Funds Over $100 Million universe reported a median return of 4.9%, with variations across different institutional segments like corporate, public funds, and foundations & endowments. U.S. fixed income also contributed positively, and Northern Trust emphasized the resilience of diversified portfolios amidst shifting economic conditions.

title: Shares of chipmakers Arm and Qualcomm slide as smartphone sales skid
summary: Shares of Arm Holdings Plc and Qualcomm Inc. both declined in after-hours trading despite differing quarterly results. Arm's stock fell due to disappointing earnings and revenues, exacerbated by a decline in smartphone sales and potential strategy shifts. Qualcomm, conversely, beat earnings and revenue expectations but saw its stock slide, possibly due to concerns over its handset business revenue and broader market sentiment.

title: Teradyne (TER) Soars 18.8% on Bullish Outlook
summary: Teradyne (NASDAQ:TER) saw an 18.88% jump in share prices following a bullish outlook from Cantor Fitzgerald, which maintained an "overweight" rating and a $105 price target. The investment firm believes Teradyne will benefit from strong demand in AI-related semiconductor test markets despite reporting dismal Q2 earnings with a significant decline in net income and revenues.

title: Meta, Microsoft Spark $500B Rally in AI Leaders and ETFs
summary: Microsoft (MSFT) and Meta Platforms (META) reported strong quarterly results, leading to a combined $500 billion increase in their market valuations and boosting AI-related stocks and ETFs. Both companies highlighted significant investments and growth in AI, with Microsoft's cloud computing division and Meta's AI-driven advertising offerings being key drivers. The article emphasizes the substantial growth potential of the AI market, projected to reach $4.8 trillion by 2033.

title: Etsy bets on its app as declines persist
summary: Etsy is focusing on its mobile app and leveraging AI to combat persistent declines in its flagship marketplace. In Q2, the company saw a 5.4% year-over-year drop in gross merchandise sales and a 4.6% decrease in active buyers, though its Depop marketplace performed better. Etsy plans to retool its ranking platform with large language models and generative AI to enhance personalized shopping experiences and improve buyer-seller connections.

title: Best American Express Cards in Canada
summary: This article by NerdWallet Canada provides a comprehensive guide to the best American Express credit cards available in Canada for various needs, such as earning cash back, Amex Membership Rewards, and Aeroplan points. It compares different Amex cards based on factors like annual fees, rewards rates, and introductory offers, and offers advice on how to choose the right card by considering spending habits, rewards programs, interest rates, and extra perks. The article also details important aspects of American Express cards, including card types, borrowing features, eligibility requirements, and tips for maximizing rewards and benefits.
